title: External statutory documents
subtitle: Request and track legal invoices in a connected accounting system. ProjectFlow billing stays your management record.

separation.disclosure: ProjectFlow does not issue tax invoices. External numbers come only from a connected provider.

status.connectionRequired: Connect an external invoicing provider to request statutory documents.
status.featureDisabled: External statutory invoicing is turned off until a provider is configured.

send.title: Send tax invoice {number}
send.description: The invoice will be sent via SUMIT to the address you choose.

fields.linkedPaymentHint: Issued for a recorded payment on this billing record

history.hint: Issued documents stay available here after refresh or when you return to this billing record.

empty.title: No external statutory document
empty.body: After SUMIT is connected, you can request a tax invoice for a finalized billing record.

reconciliation.title: Amount reconciliation
reconciliation.mismatchBanner: The invoice was issued in SUMIT but amounts do not match — review required.

accountingSection.title: Invoices and receipts
accountingSection.subtitle: Issue and track documents through your connected accounting system.
accountingSection.connectPrompt: Connect an accounting system to issue invoices and receipts through ProjectFlow.

historical.title: Previously issued documents
historical.subtitle: Documents issued earlier through a connected accounting system. View and download only.

settings.title: Invoice and receipt issuance
settings.intro: Choose whether ProjectFlow handles collections only, or also issues invoices and receipts.
settings.modeManualDescription: ProjectFlow manages billing, payments, and balances. Invoices and receipts are issued outside the system.
settings.modeExternal: Collections + invoices and receipts via ProjectFlow
settings.modeExternalDescription: ProjectFlow manages collections and issues invoices and receipts through a connected accounting system.
settings.connectProviderHint: After choosing this mode, connect an accounting system below.
settings.policySplit: Tax invoice, then receipt on payment
settings.sumitDescription: Connect your SUMIT company ID and API key. ProjectFlow talks only to the live API at api.sumit.co.il.
settings.testOnlyNotice: This connection uses the live SUMIT API at api.sumit.co.il. Credits are issued as SUMIT credit invoices linked to the original document. Cancellation uses SUMIT document cancel.
settings.invalidCompanyId: Company ID must be a positive number.
settings.expenseIngestionDescription: When enabled, ProjectFlow polls SUMIT for supplier expense documents, downloads the PDF, and runs your existing Azure OCR. Statutory invoicing settings are separate.
settings.expenseIngestionOcrRequired: Live OCR must be enabled before SUMIT can feed expense documents.

providerLimitation.creditCancel: Credit or cancel is not available from this provider connection. Billing credit notes stay management records until a statutory credit is issued.

errors.connectionRequired: Connect an external invoicing provider before requesting a statutory document.
errors.invalidCompanyId: Company ID must be a positive number.
errors.invalidApiKey: API key is missing or invalid.
errors.invalidCredentials: The connection details are not valid.
errors.moduleInactive: The SUMIT income/API module is not active on this account.
errors.providerUnreachable: SUMIT cannot be reached right now.
errors.productionBlocked: Only the SUMIT API at https://api.sumit.co.il is allowed.
errors.billingNotFinalized: Only finalized billing records can request an external statutory document.
errors.localIssuanceForbidden: Local statutory invoice issuance is not allowed.
errors.orgMismatch: Billing record does not belong to this organization.
errors.duplicateIssuanceBlocked: An external statutory document is already in progress or issued for this billing record.
errors.missingCustomerSnapshot: This billing record has no frozen customer snapshot. Link a client to the project before finalizing.
errors.ambiguousIssuance: The provider response was ambiguous. Do not retry — use recovery or contact support.
errors.providerFailed: The external invoicing provider could not complete the request.
errors.missingExternalId: This record has no external provider id yet.
errors.creditUnsupported: This provider does not support credit notes.
errors.creditNoteRequired: Create a finalized billing credit note for this invoice before SUMIT can issue a credit. The original tax invoice amounts stay unchanged.
errors.creditNoteAmbiguous: More than one billing credit note reverses this invoice. Choose the credit note to issue in SUMIT.
errors.cancelUnsupported: This provider does not support cancellation.
errors.manualModeActive: Manual mode is active — no external provider is required for business operations.
errors.paymentVoid: Cannot issue a receipt for a void payment.
errors.invalidDocumentKind: This statutory document kind is not supported for this action.
